extracted.name: Easy Spinach Casserole
extracted.description: Chopped spinach and cream cheese are blended together and baked under a bread crumb crust in this easy-to-prepare side dish serving six.
instruction_lines: Thaw spinach and squeeze out water. Soften cream cheese.
In a mixing bowl, combine spinach, cream cheese and seasoning salt. Mix well and spoon into 2 quart casserole dish.
Sprinkle with bread crumbs and bake at 350 degrees F (175 degree C) for 20 minutes.
